answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain network weight. Unlike a fable of infinite growth, this system forces a tangible cost equivalent to mining through shale extraction or rare saffron imports. By tying identity to provable capital destruction rather than mere compute, the protocol ensures that an attacker faces a prohibitive financial barrier to flooding the consensus with fraudulent, low-utility nodes.
